docs.summary: Design tokens, <tessera-root> and the UI primitives every Tessera kit is built from: buttons, form fields, menus, dialogs, popovers, tooltips, avatars, badges and toasts.
useWhen: a page needs a basic control (button, input, select, dialog) that matches the Tessera kits
wrapping a page in <tessera-root> to give its kit elements an instance and a theme
avoidWhen: the app already has a design system for basic controls; the kits work without these primitives on the page
